messages:
tess: Heads-up — small regression observed in kvcache when prefix length == 0. Need a minimal patch for 2.8.0, proposing 2.8.1. Cutoff 18:00 PT today. Who can own build + changelog + smoke?

omar: I can take build + smoke. Will open a PR with the changelog entry. Which branch should I target? release/2.8.x or create a patch branch?

vincent: target a fresh patch branch off release/2.8.0 (so we keep history clean). e.g. release/2.8-patch-<date>. I can do a quick review. Any perf implications?

_tess: No perf changes expected — it's a guard early-return in kvcache. Extremely small diff.

omar: OK creating branch release/2.8-patch-20260317 and PR. Cherry-pick approach if we need to port to other branches.

release-bot: [branch created] release/2.8-patch-20260317 by @omar. CI queued for 5 jobs.

omar: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4281 - small fix + changelog. Commit sha: abc1234def

vincent: Reviewing now. Quick nit: can you add a tiny unit test for prefix==0 case? If not, comment and I'll follow up.

omar: Will try to add it — if tight on time I'll note it for immediate follow-up.

matt: Pinged for changelog sign-off. changelog blurb suggestion: "fix(kvcache): avoid OOB when prefix length is zero". Good to go?

matt: LGTM for wording. Please keep it terse.

qa-runner: I can run the staging smoke once PR is merged. ETA ~25m after merge. Will check basic end-to-end and a KV-heavy perf sample.

omar: pushing test + updated PR in ~8m. Cherry-pick command I used:
```
git checkout -b release/2.8-patch-20260317 origin/release/2.8.0
git cherry-pick abc1234def
git push origin release/2.8-patch-20260317
```

vincent: quick review done, left 1 tiny suggestion (non-blocking). Code change is tiny and clear.

release-bot: CI passed for PR #4281 — all checks green.

omar: merging now.

release-bot: PR #4281 merged by @omar into release/2.8-patch-20260317. Draft tag: v2.8.1-rc1. Docker build started.

qa-runner: Smoke on staging started. Running: basic API, kv stress, latency dashboards.

qa-runner: Smoke passed (staging). KV stress run looked stable, no error spike. Latency within normal bounds.

omar: Tagged and pushed docker: `redwood-inference/redwood:2.8.1-hotpatch` (sha: def4567). Changelog updated in PR.

matt: :thumbsup: I'll approve the deploy.

_tess: Thanks all. Deploy plan: 5% canary -> 30m observe -> 100% rollout if no regressions. Kicking off at 18:15 PT. If we don't have merged PR + green smoke by 17:30 we'll move to next window.

vincent: Noted. I'll keep alert watch for metrics.

omar: Done and monitoring logs. If anything shows up I'll revert immediately.

release-bot: Production rollout started: canary=5% for v2.8.1 at 2026-03-17T18:15:00-07:00.

qa-runner: Canary smoke passed after 10m. No errors.

tess: Great job, quick turn. Filing a follow-up ticket to add the unit test (if missing) and a short postmortem note in the release doc. :shipit:
